title: Instant Millet Noodles - Veggie Masala
body_html:
• No Maida, 100% vegetarian instant noodles made with a wholesome blend of jowar and whole wheat - perfect for a light, tasty snack for two

  • Comes with 2 spice mix sachets made using 100% natural Indian spices, with real air dried vegetables - carrot, cabbage, french beans, green peas and sweet corn.

  • Noodle cakes are air-dried and not fried

  • Made by two mothers, with a whole lot of love!

  • Perfect evening snack that won’t make your child skip dinner. To make 1 portion, split the noodle cake in half and use only one spice mix sachet. To make two portions, use the full cake and both spice mix sachets. Your kid gets a yummy, light snack without getting too full or skipping dinner!

  • Keep in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep in an airtight container and consume within 30 days.

How to make:

    • Single serving for one: Boil ¾ cup water. Break one noodle cake into two equal halves. Add half the cake of noodles to the boiling water. Stir and cook for 5-6 minutes till the water reduces. Add only 1 spice mix sachet to the noodles. Stir and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Serve hot!

    • Double serving for two: Boil 1 ½ cup water. Add the full noodle cake to the boiling water. Stir and cook for 5-6 minutes till the water reduces. Add the 2 spice mix sachets to the noodles. Stir and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Serve hot!
